title: AuditEvent
description: One append-only, hash-chained lifecycle event (one JSONL line). event_hash = SHA-256 over canonical serialization of (sequence, occurred_at, kind, request_id, payload, prev_hash). Tamper-EVIDENT, not immutable (ADR-007). Never contains key material.

sequence.description: monotonic, gap-free within one log file

kind.description: distinguishes requested intent, decoded intent, simulated result, policy outcome, user decision, signature result, broadcast result, failures, revocations (BP §4.17)

request_id.description: null for events not tied to a request (e.g. VaultLocked)

payload.description: kind-specific structured payload (referenced schema instances or summaries); never key material, never full raw signatures beyond broadcast artifacts

prev_hash.description: hash of previous event; genesis uses sha256 of the fixed tag 'cipherlayer-audit-genesis-v1'
